source: Caller supplies complete decoded row-major RGBA bytes, positive integer dimensions, named original frame, imageId, expected full RGBA SHA256, source PNG SHA256 and explicit decoder name/version/output mode. Separate Pillow staging accepts an existing PNG and expected PNG SHA256; verifies bytes before decode; no EXIF orientation, ICC/gamma transform, resize, flattening or alpha muting. RGB/RGBA PNG only; RGB expansion appends alpha255. Other modes explicitly unsupported.
roi: Explicit named crop frame and integer xPx,yPx,widthPx,heightPx, entirely inside original. No padding, clamping, resize or implicit ROI. Copy each complete source RGBA row span exactly. SHA256 binds full RGBA and copied crop RGBA independently.
geometry: Caller supplies same-original-frame composition geometry and geometrySource testimony. Translate every training tee/badge, station origin and occluder box origin by exactly (-roi.xPx,-roi.yPx). Preserve box dimensions, headings, station windows, LOCAL width values and edge-search settings. Unsupported fields and unsupported geometry return UNKNOWN before operations; never silently discard supplied geometry. No identity, acceptance or calibrated width follows.
support: Conservative prerequisite: all full training segments and station profile-window endpoints, expanded by explicit operation support bounds, lie strictly inside crop pixel safety rectangle x>1,y>1,x<width-2,y<height-2. Profile normal extent30px; sensor tangent4px plus max(2*max(1,width)/3,max(1,width)/2+2.5) normal extent. This may reject usable crops and is labelled conservative, not a CV validity result. Insufficient support returns UNKNOWN with zero composition calls; no hidden edge sampling/clamping/padding. Empty training/bank/station collections retain existing meaning.
integrity: Missing/malformed evidence returns UNKNOWN and zero operations. A supplied well-formed full RGBA hash that disagrees throws an integrity error. Frozen accepted recipe+vendor closure is verified before enabled composition invocation. Any crop/snapshot hash mismatch throws. Missing PNG bytes in JS means original encoded PNG hash is caller/stager testimony, explicitly labelled; JS verifies full/crop RGBA, not encoded PNG bytes.
immutability: Preparation snapshots full RGBA, geometry and metadata before crop and operation. Returned preparation and receipt are recursively frozen plain objects/arrays; caller mutation cannot alter prepared bytes or geometry. Existing composition performs its own RGBA snapshot. No writes/network/default-on integration.
control: Explicit synthetic contract fixtures only before candidate freeze: exact crop RGBA including alpha, translation of every geometry kind, unsupported/missing/integrity negative controls, support rejection, mutable-caller isolation and full-vs-crop same-operation comparison within numeric tolerance1e-9 for raw diagnostic outputs. Actual PNG integration belongs to independent course producers/reviewer after candidate freeze. No course data is inspected or tuned to.
boundaries: No semantic promotion, score/width acceptance or fake identity
